ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Write the Boolean expression for \( f \) implemented by the two-input multiplexer circuit shown in the figure.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two 2-to-1 MUXs in the figure. Data input 0 of the lower MUX is connected to C, data input 1 is connected to \overline{C}, and its select terminal is at the bottom, labeled B. The output of the lower MUX is connected to the select terminal of the upper MUX. Data input 0 of the upper MUX is drawn as a low-level/0 input, data input 1 is connected to A, and the output terminal is labeled f. Reasoning: The output rule of a 2-to-1 MUX is Y = \overline{S}D_0 + SD_1. The select signal of the lower MUX is B, so its output is \overline{B}C + B\overline{C}. This output serves as the select signal of the upper MUX. For the upper MUX, D_0 = 0 and D_1 = A, therefore f = \overline{S}\cdot 0 + S\cdot A = A S, where S = \overline{B}C + B\overline{C}. So f = A(\overline{B}C + B\overline{C}) = A\overline{B}C + AB\overline{C}.
